title: DrUltraLux's Steam Fantasy
description: A Steampunk/Magitech inspired Modpack set in a dying fantasy world where players survive by building their own cities and airships.
body:
_A Steampunk/Magitech inspired Modpack set in a dying fantasy world where players survive by building their own cities and airships._

Made for my own community server, but free for anyone to use. 

**Currently missing dedicated server pack, but I am working on that for future releases**

**Pack now on Neoforge 1.21.1!**

- Uses [BiomeReplacer](https://modrinth.com/mod/biome-replacer) to convert most of the world to dry/hot environments. 
- [Continents](https://modrinth.com/datapack/continents), and many other modifications to world generation for a more unique minecraft world. 
- [Cold Sweat](https://modrinth.com/mod/cold-sweat) and [Thirst Was Reclaimed](https://modrinth.com/mod/thirst-was-reclaimed) makes survival difficult. Now also includes [Nourished](https://modrinth.com/mod/nourished) for more immersive diets, only eating bread now has consequences.
- [Cold Sweat:Altittude](https://modrinth.com/mod/cold-sweat-altitude) makes mining and flying high altitudes difficult
- [Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn](https://modrinth.com/mod/minecraft-comes-alive-reborn) along with [Townstead](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/townstead) and [Ribbits](https://modrinth.com/mod/ribbits) for players to build up a functioning society out of the ruins of a dying world. 
- [Rule your new kingdom using MCA Capitals!](https://modrinth.com/mod/capitals-a-monarchy-mod-for-mca-reborn) become a monarch and establish noble houses. 
- [Create: Aernoautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics) and many others to make ships and airships using steam, source/mana or just old fashioned hot air balloons or sails! Also includes [Create:Deep Seas](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-deep-seas) to allow submarines!
- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) and addons for automation and technical work.
- [Iron's Spells](https://modrinth.com/mod/irons-spells-n-spellbooks) and [Ars Nouveau](https://modrinth.com/mod/ars-nouveau) for magical and fantasy content. [Ars Creo](https://modrinth.com/mod/ars-creo) and [Ars Technica](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ars-technica) for Create integration. 
- [Better Combat](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-combat) and [Knight Quest](https://modrinth.com/mod/knight-quest) for combat. 
- Overhauled Dynamic weather, seasonal and clouds systems using [Simple Clouds](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-clouds), [Project Atmosphere](https://modrinth.com/mod/project-atmosphere), [Serene Seasons](https://modrinth.com/mod/serene-seasons) via [Ecliptic Seasons Bridge API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/serene-seasons-api-stub-ecliptic-seasons-bridge)
- Dynamic Party systems for both pvp and pve combat organisation built around [Party System](https://modrinth.com/mod/party-system-hud)

Included in pack are optional resource packs and shaders. [3D Muskets](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/3d-muskets). [Ars Brassified Create](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ars-nouveau-brass-ified-create-style-anbics) and [Iron's Weapons reimagined](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/irons-spells-weapons-reimagined) and the adorable [Looshy](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/looshy).
